notes.title: Introducing Multi-Table Tournaments!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33473979/89bdf3fe3ad7092fa5bd88d6b33b2bd1a92e86d9.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce the release of a long awaited game type - MTTs! A "Multi-Table Tournament" (or MTT) is a tournament in which multiple tables of players play down to just one table, where a winner will eventually be crowned. An unlimited number of players can join, with each player adding to the prize pool!

Players can advance without having to beat everyone at their table, which differs from our previous Shootout format.

Currently, you can check out the in-game Lobby to play in Season of Shadows MTTs using a Pumpkin Token as entry. 

Good luck and have fun!

[b]We've added the long-awaited Multi-Table Tournament (MTT) game mode! [/b]
True to the name, MTTs take place over many tables at once. However, unlike Shootouts, this mode will jump players to new tables as others are eliminated (or new players join) to keep a relative balance. notes.title: HD Poker official Card Shuffler/RNG certification
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33473979/bcc812c2b6e7664a3996d5e1731e1c1a9889d50c.png[/img]

HD Poker prides itself on being a fair and trusted gaming platform.

HD Poker has received official certification for Card Shuffler / RNG via one of the most prestigious independent testing laboratories, Gaming Laboratories International, LLC (GLI). This means that the card shuffler used in HD Poker meets the highest possible standards for Random Number Generation (RNG), which is the same standard used in Real Money.

https://gaminglabs.com/

HD's certification can be found on GLI's website here:

https://access.gaminglabs.com/Certificate/Index?i=402

In a game like Poker, the order in which the cards are dealt is critical. The RNG algorithm used determines the sequence in which cards are drawn from the deck. By using a certified RNG algorithm, HD Poker guarantees that this sequence is random and thus, the outcome of the game is random and does not follow any pattern.

Ensuring an authentic poker experience is of the utmost importance to our team. Official certification of our RNG to ensure fair dealing is just one of the many steps that we are taking to provide the best poker gameplay experience possible.

notes.title: Sunday Invitational Week 25 Recap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33473979/5973af9f03fd5fea54032ac4c8d37475746664d4.png[/img]

Our friend DeOnnaJ is back on top again in Week 25 of the Sunday Invitational. How exciting to see back-to-back wins for her! Let’s recap those final moments.

In a head-to-head match against xDSJx06, things got interesting when the blinds were raised to 5B/10B. With 32.09B left in their pot, xDSJx06 went all-in and DeOnnaJ called it. xDSJx06 had 99.05% odds at the start of the hand and ended up acquiring a four of a kind. Nice!

Two hands later, xDSJx06 started by raising to 30B, but DeOnnaJ took it up another notch by going all-in, which xDSJx06 called. Holding 4♠ and 4♣, DeOnnaJ had the better odds, which proved true when she got a two pair on the river.

With only 6.62B left in xDSJx06’s pot, the final round was at hand. Again, DeOnnaJ had the better odds on the flop. And like in the previous hand, she amazingly got another two pair. Congrats on the win again, DeOnnaJ!

Celebrate her win with some free chips! Available for a limited time, just head to the HD Poker in-game store, click on Enter Code, and enter WEEK25WINNER.

Be sure to drink some water and enjoy some good vibes this week!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33473979/ad023a8cf9f52d0b8a7b20becf497db63d62f734.png[/img]

[b]The HD Poker 1.7 update is now rolling out to all players! With so many additions, this is one of our most awesome updates ever![/b]

Trade gems to your friends just as you would any other item.

[h3][b]Other technical details include:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Faster loading and improved connectivity

Thanks for playing HD Poker, and for being an awesome part of our community!

notes.title: UPDATE: Halloween Time Event and Major Updates
notes.content:
[b]Halloween[/b]
- Halloween Time is finally here!
- Introducing our Halloween Spooky Mega Pack, Chests, Avatars & Poker Rooms!

[b]Changes to Table Stakes[/b]
- Restructured the Table Stakes and Buy-Ins
- Brought back several highly requested Table Stakes

[b]Emotes[/b]
- Players can now collect Emotes in their Inventory
- Emotes can be purchased in the Store or found in Chests
- Emote picker will now display the Emotes a player actually owns

[b]Leaderboards and Weekly Rewards[/b]
- Greatly Increased Weekly Rewards! 
- Increased Poker Skill Rating (PSR) Bonuses for playing Higher Stakes

[b]Free Bonus[/b]
- Bonuses are now random and reward approximately 60% more chips than before!
- Increased the chance to find gems in the first four steps of collection
- Free Bonus Chest after 5 collections has greatly increased drops, including more chips, gems, and a chance to find Avatars!

[b]Table Chests[/b]
- Increased the amount of rewards in table chests
- Keep your eye out for special Great Pumpkin table chests!

[b](Re) Introducing Our Avatar Cast[/b]
- The largest update ever to our HD Poker Team of Avatars! 
- A number of Avatars of have been renamed

[b]Name Change Contracts and XP Boosts[/b]
- Players are now no longer limited on the number of name changes and can purchase Name Change Contracts from the Store
- Level up faster and get more rewards by purchasing XP Boost items in the Store or finding them in Chests!

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]
+ Many optimizations made to improve performance and quality of life
